asr.full_text: Welcome to MirroTrading International Part 3 Maximizing your Bitcoin investment The focus of MirroTrading International is to grow your Bitcoin and the focus of MTI is on the investor. MirroTrading International has an optional Affiliate Program and many investors are not interested in the Affiliate Program at all. However, even for the investor, with a little creativity the affiliate program can add to your earnings. There are two main advantages to becoming part of the MTI affiliate program. Number one, you'll receive a 10% referral Commission on all amounts invested by people you personally introduce, and whenever more funds are added over and above the original amount you'll receive 10% on the new amount invested. Two, there is a weekly binary profit share. When you look at your MTI back office you will see that there is a left team and a right team. Upon starting, you will usually have zero team members on the left and right as well as zero bitcoin volume in either leg. You will also see that you have zero direct referrals and under Binary Bonuses it states Not Binary Qualified. To be Binary Qualified you will need a minimum of $200 in your trading account and have two direct referrals, one placed in the left team and the other in the right team. You're probably thinking but I just want to invest. I'm not interested in recruiting. But have an open mind! I will show you a way of earning extra. I have never yet met anyone who said they had enough money. Here is the possibility. What if you open two positions for family members? It could be your grandmother and grandfather, one on the left and one on the right. You could help them and give them a portion of your earnings, if you wanted to. Now let's assume you invested 0.1 Bitcoin on the left and 0.15 Bitcoin on the right. The total Bitcoin volume of the team on the left is 0 time is btc0.1 and this is your weakest team leg because you have at least $200 in your personal trading account you'll receive the weekly binary profit share. You can increase this weekly bonus by adding more investment into the weakest team of your business and you'll continue to get paid on whichever is the weakest leg. You can add more to your investment, or more team members and you'll benefit even further. These are the possibilities of maximizing your investment using the MTI system. If you have any questions, please contact the person who sent you this video.

textual.potential_relevance: A promised investment-related return is linked to maintaining a stated minimum account balance, requiring later assessment of the claim, conditions and promotional context.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether Bitcoin growth or profit-share payments occurred, were guaranteed, or were available under additional terms.

textual.observation: The video describes a 10% referral commission on amounts invested by people personally introduced by the participant, including later additional investments.

textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether commissions were paid, how eligibility was verified, or whether additional restrictions applied.

textual.observation: The speaker links eligibility for the weekly binary profit share to having two direct referrals, one placed on each side of a left/right team structure, in addition to the minimum account balance.

visual.observation: Slides present a "Weekly Binary Profit Share," show BTC amounts for left and right teams, and state that payment is made weekly on Saturday if the week’s trading results are positive.
visual.context: Visible instructional or promotional slide context for Mirror Trading International; the broader purpose of the presentation is not independently established from the sampled frames.
visual.potential_relevance: A recurring BTC return claim is explicitly linked to trading performance and a binary team structure, creating a task-relevant reward-and-condition relationship for review.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish that any payment occurred, how the BTC amounts were calculated, whether the figures are examples or account data, or whether the stated results were achieved.

visual.observation: The affiliate-program slides describe a 10% referral commission, a $200 minimum investment, and two direct referrals with one placed in the left team and one in the right team.
visual.context: The affiliate program is labeled "Optional" in the presentation.
visual.potential_relevance: Referral recruitment and a monetary benefit are explicitly connected to an upfront investment requirement and a left/right team-placement condition.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show how referrals are contacted, whether commissions are paid, whether the investment is refundable, or whether participants actually joined or transferred funds.

visual.observation: A slide instructs viewers to focus on adding investment to the weakest team leg and states that any amount of Bitcoin can be added at any time.
visual.context: The instruction appears within the same binary team and profit-share presentation.
visual.potential_relevance: The request to add Bitcoin is tied to improving a team leg within the stated profit-share structure, linking an asset transfer to a promised benefit.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish that anyone followed the instruction, where Bitcoin would be sent, what controls or permissions were involved, or what outcome would result.

visual_context_notes.observation: The opening slide identifies Mirror Trading International and frames the presentation around maximising a Bitcoin investment.
The final slide directs viewers to contact the person who sent the video for questions.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes Mirror Trading International as a way to grow Bitcoin through a weekly binary profit share tied to a $200 trading-account balance and two direct referrals in opposing team positions. It offers a 10% commission for introducing people who invest, instructs participants to add Bitcoin to the weaker team leg, and directs questions to the sender. the available video evidence does not establish that payments occurred or returns were achieved.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central earning mechanism depends on personally introducing investors, receiving commissions on their investments, maintaining two direct referrals, and placing those referrals in left and right team positions. The video also links adding team members or investment to further benefits.
